items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: I’m the one that said to Gil Roden, form a small band out of those guys, those wonderful guys, Eddie Miller and those guys

ctx.x: Yes. He talked about that in the books I’ve read, in that he didn’t try to mimic them specifically, but it was more of an ambiance or —

Inspired. So was Monk. Same thing. And anyway, after that well there was a period there, in years perhaps, that completed my career because then I went into the Office of Strategic Services, which was America’s spy unit, you know, and we went abroad, and we sent bodies in France and things like that you know. So that followed and that ended that period of mine. But at that time it was nice, because I worked with Mildred [Bailey] and Red [Norvo] a certain amount, but various people. The Crosby band, I’m the one…
